what: Criterion 5 and criterion 11 of Issue #364: one substitution per half of the guard, each reddening its own half and no other. Run against the committed state b312d97, not against a working copy — reverting a mutant applied to uncommitted work would take the work with it.

base.howObtained: git log --oneline -1 in C:/gamedev/_wt-364-world-labels before the first mutant was applied

mutations.half: attachment — a caption must not drift off the body it names
mutations.why: This is the slot ladder without a ceiling, in one constant: the candidate rungs are built up to MaximumAttachmentRef, so raising it restores exactly the technique Issue #364 forbids — each next caption a step higher, with nothing stopping it.
output: «Секира» sits 59,00 reference pixels from its body at tick 2380; the limit is 22.
«Крюк Немой» sits 37,00 reference pixels from its body at tick 2025; the limit is 22.
mutations.verdict: red on both frames of the owner's scene

mutations.half: overlap — two captions must not be printed over one another
mutations.why: Removes the resolution itself and nothing else. Every label then takes the first candidate — centred over its own head — which is where they were before bands existed.
output: «Тишина READY» and «Секира» share pixels at tick 2380
«Кремень DOWN» and «Крюк Немой» share pixels at tick 2025
mutations.verdict: red on both frames — and the named pairs are one crew label against one raider caption, which is the collision that could not be resolved anywhere before this layout existed

mutations.half: picking — a raider must be in the set the pointer chooses from
mutations.was:
.. state.Raiders
                .Where(raider => raider.Position == cell && raider.Mode != RaiderMode.Escaped)
                .OrderBy(raider => raider.Id)
                .Select(raider => new WorldLabelSubject(WorldLabelKind.Raider, raider.Id)),
mutations.why: Returns picking to «only the creatures of the domain», which is what Main.Player.cs did before the addendum of 2026-08-10. Restated for the rework round, because the raider branch moved into BodiesAt when repeated clicking was added; re-run in this form.
output: Assert.NotEmpty() Failure: Collection was empty — no raider is reachable on any cell

mutations.half: picking — repeated clicking must reach every body of a cell
mutations.was:
var current = selected is { } body ? IndexOf(bodies, body) : -1;
        return bodies[(current + 1) % bodies.Count];
mutations.why: Returns the answer to what it was before the rework round: a cell always answers with its first body, so everything standing behind that body is unreachable. This is the substitution finding F1 demands a guard against.
output: Assert.DoesNotContain() Failure: Item found in collection — the cycle returns the same body twice and never reaches the rest
mutations.verdict: red on both frames and on the captioned-returner check

afterEachMutation: git checkout -- src/DungeonFortress.Presentation/WorldLabelLayout.cs, then git status --short printed nothing.

ringIsCoveredWithoutAFourthMutation.why: Point 3 of the addendum — the selection ring — is covered by criterion 9 rather than by a mutation of its own, which is what the coordinator allowed provided the cover is named.
ringIsCoveredWithoutAFourthMutation.named: WorldLabelInspectorTests.The_adapter_rings_the_selected_body_of_either_kind reads the adapter source and requires both DrawCreatureInformation and DrawRaiderInformation to draw the ring through WorldSelectionMark.

measuredAnyway.was: the eight-line ring block inside DrawRaiderInformation
measuredAnyway.became: removed entirely — which is the state Issue #364 found the adapter in
measuredAnyway.output: Assert.Contains() Failure: Sub-string not found — the DrawRaiderInformation case red, the DrawCreatureInformation case still green, so the check separates the two halves rather than failing wholesale.

reworkRound.why: Independent review of PR #368 returned RETURN on finding F1: WorldLabels answered a cell with one body, so four of the six captioned returners of the owner wave-4 frame could not be selected at all. Criterion 9 was green while the property was broken, because it filtered out exactly the cells where the defect lived.
reworkRound.measuredBefore: review probe: #17 Секира at (15,7) pickedExactly=False crewOnCell=Тишина, and the same for #18 Сиплый, #19 Ловчий, #22 Косой. Only #20 Долговязый on (16,7) was selectable.

Six of six reachable; the worst cell costs five clicks to go round.
